test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Grow
solution: The correct answer is: **Shrink**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Antonym means a word that has the opposite meaning of the given word. • **Grow **means to increase in size or quantity. (आकार या मात्रा में वृद्धि करना) • **Example**: *The company implemented effective strategies, leading to a significant grow in its market share.* • Marked option **shrink **means to decrease in size or quantity. (आकार या मात्रा में कमी होना) • **Example**: *Due to economic challenges, the company had to shrink its workforce to maintain financial stability.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Crimp **means to fold or bend into small, tight, or irregular folds. (छोटे, तंग या अनियमित तहों में मोड़ना) • **Plant **means to put a seed or plant in the ground to grow. (किसी बीज या पौधे को उगने के लिए जमीन में गाड़ना) • **Alter **means to change or modify something. (किसी चीज़ को बदलना या संशोधित करना) 17d:T8e4, The correct answer is: **Snug**.
